reuse.why: Puts the check in the existing accounts/link.ts module beside findOrCreateBank, which all link handlers already import, and calls it from each handler.

duplication.why: The query and error are defined once; the five handlers only make a one-line call with their provider name.

placement.why: link.ts is the module the tree uses for shared linking logic, so the rule lives where the link handlers already go for bank-link decisions.

scope.why: Only the new check, its five call sites and its unit tests are added.

maintainability.why: Changing what counts as 'already linked' means editing one function, and each provider handler calls it before any write or network call.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No handler checks for an existing link on its own; all use link.ensureAccountNotLinked.

one_place.where: link.ts ensureAccountNotLinked is the single definition, called by the GoCardless, SimpleFin, Pluggy.ai, Akahu and Enable Banking link handlers in accounts/app.ts.
